task: Ensure explicit Margo module builds run Java semantic validation before emitting interfaces and Rust.
observation: The explicit-module ProjectBuilder path previously emitted .mossi and Rust without invoking CheckedProgram. A bounded invalid local provider/consumer project therefore had no semantic gate before backend generation. The build now constructs a checker view with the current module, transitive local imports, and imported ABI declarations materialized by the existing verified Main.loadMossiFunctions loader. Repeated built-in declarations are deduplicated by rewritten declaration identity.
impact: The ProjectBuilder regression with a local provider import and return mismatch now fails with a semantic diagnostic before native compilation. External ABI declarations flow through the existing ABI-v9/v10 loader, whose source-free function tests pass in both modes; the full ProjectBuilder external-provider/link path was not exercised.

resolution.summary: Java build and all ten unit-test classes pass in default ABI-v9 and staged ABI-v10 modes; the focused local provider/consumer project fails at TYPE_MISMATCH before rustc. Native external provider-consumer linking and full source-free Margo acceptance remain open.
